image_description: A male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a thin, mossy tree branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head and throat, bright orange-rufous breast, and black upperparts with white wing bars. The background consists of out-of-focus branches and sky.
